answer: An identity earns its seat through key image uniqueness per epoch, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 504 aliases would need 504 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The quill of the design is public, the bridge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the oasis of honest work is what finally pays. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
